messages:
olivia tran: FYI team 1    Quick procurement update: temporary controls for non-critical vendor onboarding while we finish the Q2 reforecast. Effective immediately through 2026-05-20. Key points: 1) New SaaS subscriptions > $3,000/yr require finance + procurement signoff before purchase. 2) Travel reimbursements > $750 need manager pre-approval. 3) Office & marketing vendor categories are paused for new signups unless marked business-critical. Policy: https://redwood.internal/finance/temp-controls (internal).

mike rutherford: Does this apply to renewals? We have a Datadog renewal for $4.2k next week.

procurement-bot: Auto: Renewals that are auto-pay and already on the books are grandfathered if the subscription was approved before 2026-05-01. If you plan to make changes to the contract or increase seats, submit a Vendor Change Request.

jess kim: Quick process q: for contractors who need tooling (Figma, etc.), should PMs bundle tools under one vendor request or do individual requests per tool?

olivia tran: Bundle if they are from the same supplier and under the same billing entity. Otherwise separate vendor requests. Please include expected seat count + start/end dates to speed review.

mike rutherford: tagged @procurement 1 here. We'll submit the Datadog renewal request with the current PO attached.

procurement-bot: Note: To request an exception use https://redwood.internal/procurement/expedite and attach the SOW/invoice. Typical turnaround: 24 business hours.

finance-bot: Implementation note: new thresholds will be enforced by our approval workflow on 2026-05-05 00:00 UTC. Expense reports submitted after that time will be processed under the new rules.

jess kim: Small ask 1   Could we get a short checklist for managers approving travel? A couple of PMs are unclear on the pre-approval workflow.

olivia tran: Yes 1 I'll post a manager checklist in #announcements and run a 30-min drop-in Thursday 08:30 PT to walk through examples (domestic vs international travel). Calendar invite to follow.

mike rutherford: Thanks  I'll flag the Datadog renewal and submit the change request now.

olivia tran: Thanks all  procurement and finance will triage expedite requests within one business day. If the vendor touches customer data, please loop Legal and Security early.
